outcome: Use of labor analgesia (nitrous oxide, epidural, other medical analgesia, non-medical analgesia)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of women with singleton pregnancies in Finland between 2004 and 2018 for whom smoking status and socioeconomic status data were available.
finding: Women who continued smoking after the first trimester used labor analgesia more often than non-smokers, while socioeconomic status showed no substantial differences in labor analgesia use.
